skills.value: Acrobatics +11, Deception +11, Diplomacy +11, Nature +10, Occultism +9, Stealth +9

description.value: You grant the target brief foresight. The target gains a +1 status bonus to its next initiative roll, after which the spell ends.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (+2): The status bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +4 at 7th level.

description.value: You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

You create an auditory illusion of simple sounds that has a maximum volume equal to four normal humans shouting.

The sounds emanate from a square you designate within range. You can't create intelligible words or other intricate sounds (such as music).

higher_level_description.value:
Heightened (3th): The range increases to 60 feet.

Heightened (5th): The range increases to 120 feet.

targets.value: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature

description.value:
You channel positive energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of positive damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (material, somatic, verbal) You disperse positive energy in a 30-foot emanation. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (+1): The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

targets.value: non-magical object of light Bulk or less

description.value: You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell level to the target, potentially removing the broken condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

higher_level_description.value:
Heightened (2th): You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3th): You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

description.value:
With a touch, you ease a creature's fears. You can attempt to counteract a single fear effect that the target suffers from.

This frees only the target, not any other creatures under the fear effect.

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (6th): The spell's range increases to 30 feet, and you can target up to 10 creatures.
